messages:
lee_cs: @ravi_customer thanks for the intake form. looping SE and Safety to scope LumenBridge's clinical ensemble request. quick summary from the doc: private deployment (VPC), PHI-rich records, HSM for keying, want a mixed 13b ensemble (base + domain-adapted tune) with a 7b low-latency fallback. target 120 reqs/s, p95 <350ms, and transparent audit trail. do I have that right?
ravi_customer: yep that's right. also need deterministic redaction for PHI fields and an explainability hook for auditors. can you share an onboarding checklist?
lee_cs: will do. omar, best infra approach?
omar_se: for that throughput we recommend Dedicated pool with 10 GPUs (A10 or T4 depending on region). quantization: q4_k_m or q5_0 for 13b to balance latency + fidelity; fallback 7b q4_0. continuous batching window 50ms, dynamic KV cache for multi-turn summaries. storage: customer-controlled S3 in VPC, we won't duplicate raw docs.
trina_safety: Safety checklist: 1) red-team dataset (we need 400 targeted prompts simulating PHI exfil attempts) 2) automatic PII/PHI scanner on outputs 3) deterministic redaction layer + record of original->sanitized mapping (hashes only) 4) hallucination tests and summary accuracy metrics. we also need the customer's compliance contact and BAA confirmation.
priya_am: commercial note: if LumenBridge opts for Dedicated/Private we should present 12/24 month reserved capacity pricing vs pay-as-you-go. Ravi: have you got contracting constraints or renewal cadence we should be aware of?
ravi_customer: expecting 12 month commitment, procurement needs vendor security questionnaire answered by next week.
lee_cs: perfect. actionables: we'll produce an onboarding OnePager, infra sketch, and eval plan.
omar_se: rollout proposal: week 0-2 safety eval + infra provisioning in a staging VPC -> week 3 canary (5% traffic) for 7 days -> metrics pass -> week 5 full ramp. Canary pass criteria: PHI leakage <0.3% on scanner, F1 on redaction >0.98, p95 latency <350ms, no critical findings in red-team.
trina_safety: note: F1 threshold for redaction might be tightened depending on legal. we'll run both lenient and strict thresholds and surface tradeoffs. also request: do not include raw PHI in any test S3 buckets; use tokenized/mock variants unless BAA allows otherwise.
priya_am: commercial risk: if performance/latency isn't met by week 6 we may need interim SLA credit or fallback to hosted. I'll draft options.
ops-bot: ticket created CS-9007: LumenBridge clinical ensemble intake. assignees: omar_se, trina_safety, lee_cs.
lee_cs: assigned action list: 1) ravi to upload sample prompts + procurement questionnaire (by Tue) 2) omar to provide infra cost estimate and quant profiles (48h) 3) trina to draft red-team matrix and eval rubric (72h) 4) priya to prepare pricing & contract options (72h). I'll schedule a 30m kickoff touch with LumenBridge after uploads. :calendar:
ravi_customer: I'll push sample set and questionnaire to the secure intake bucket tonight and share ACLs. can we get a recorded enablement session for our engs?
omar_se: yes we will run a 60m enablement: deployment ops, rollback playbook, and telemetry dashboards. will record.	rina_safety: we'll include the eval rubric and replay scripts. if LumenBridge wants HSM log signing, confirm vendor for HSM integration (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault HSM, or on-prem HSM appliance).
ravi_customer: using AWS CloudHSM in our VPC.
lee_cs: noted. next step: I'll send the OnePager + intake ticket link and calendar invite. thanks all! :thumbsup:
